service db: command: it adds arguments to the image's own entrypoint, and an oci.entrypoint written in a stack replaces the entrypoint as well as the command, so import cannot tell what to put before them offline; write `entrypoint:` too, with the image's own (Entrypoint in `docker inspect IMAGE` or `skopeo inspect --config docker://IMAGE`; `tink run IMAGE ARGS` prints it)
